videoTitle: Your Birth Control Might Be Changing Your Mood—But Not All Pills Do
videoDescription: Feeling flatter or more anxious since starting hormonal birth control? The research says it's real—and the type of progestin in your method matters more than you think. Find out which hormones are linked to mood changes and which aren't. Read the full breakdown at mindtivate.com.
script: You've been told mood changes on birth control are all in your head. Turns out the research says it's real, and it's not about birth control as one thing—it's about which specific progestin you're on, and some actually improve mood while others...
Visit mindtivate.com to find the answer.
